integrity: The proof uses the published automorphism group, singular-orbit classification, trivial-point orbit, and the two 64-conic families. The new orbit and incidence statements are then derived by an explicit canonical conic, a Jacobian minor, square-pattern comparison, and exact double counting. A packaged script checks all finite arithmetic and polynomial identities but is not presented as a replacement for the cited geometric inputs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the 128 rational conics already identified as the three-distinct-entry locus Z_3. It does not prove that these exhaust all conics, determine the scheme structure of the conic Hilbert locus, or classify all pairwise conic intersections.
title: Orbit-incidence structure of the 128 known conics on the magic-square surface
